placements.why: The content describes a formal internal onboarding process (a checklist, its required steps, and its supersession of a prior artifact) — an organizational-governance category with no existing strata match. This is a genuine new top-level category, not a leaf-grain theme, since it names the kind of organizational-process subject future envelopes about internal operating procedures would nest under.
placements.title: Organization
placements.frame: What structural processes and standing artifacts does the org run to govern its own people and operations?

placements.title: Onboarding shifts from ad hoc reference to a mandatory, structured ritual
placements.frame: What does each new onboarding-related expression reveal about how the org is standardizing, replacing, or ratifying its formal entry process for new hires?
placements.why: Both segments describe the same directional theme: onboarding as a codified, mandatory ritual (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) that has formally displaced an older, looser artifact (the wiki page). This is a subject future envelopes about onboarding evolution will keep feeding, not a one-time fact — the checklist's existence and its supersession event are evidence for this theme rather than facts standing alone. No existing leaf structure exists yet in this repo to hold it.
